text:
I visited this clinic twice for an eye problem.
My condition seemed to be improving, but I received a phone call reminding me to return the next day for a follow-up visit. The reminder call made me feel a little pressured to return.
During the second visit, I was charged more than the first visit, which was unexpected for a follow-up appointment based on my past experiences at other clinics. I was also given the same medicine that I already had, and I still had a significant amount of the medicine from the first prescription remaining at that time.
Also, unlike other clinics I have visited, I did not receive a detailed receipt for the medication. I could not see how much was charged for the consultation and how much for the medicine.
I hope the clinic can provide clearer explanations about whether follow-up visits are really necessary, avoid re-prescribing medicine when patients already have enough remaining, and give patients a detailed receipt for transparency.
